title: Certificate of operation
description: What to have ready before applying to AMSA for a certificate of operation. Summarised from AMSA's guidance and Marine Order 504.

sources.title: Marine Order 504 (Certificates of operation – national law) 2024

items.title: Write your safety management system
items.detail: The application includes a written statement that each vessel has an SMS that meets Marine Order 504. Use the SMS builder on this project.

items.title: Do and record your crewing assessment
items.detail: Recorded in the SMS. Vessels of 80 metres, 3000 GT or 3000 kW or more need a crewing determination from AMSA instead.

items.title: Name your designated person
items.detail: Someone who monitors safety and can be reached by the master and crew. The owner can be the designated person.

items.title: Adopt a drug and alcohol policy
Check the master and crew hold the certificates of competency they need
Apply to AMSA with Form 504
items.detail: A certificate of operation doesn't transfer with a vessel: a new owner applies again. Renewals use Form 553.

items.title: Record the certificate and its expiry in your vessel's certificates
